objects.name: Analytic 2157
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux engineering tool issuing device restart commands outside a scheduled maintenance window, from a User Identifier (UID) not in the approved engineer list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): syscall=execve; device restart/shutdown command invoked outside the approved change-control window by an unauthorized UID
